name: Nova Steal
source:
Nova Steal is a mutant telekinetic with an insatiable passion for firearms, capable of manipulating objects at a distance with the power of her mind and using them with lethal precision. Her obsession with money and power drives her to commit ruthless acts, amassing wealth with every blow struck. Her strategic mind and telekinetic control make her a formidable threat, always ready to exploit every opportunity to further enrich herself, without scruples.
